===Synergy Bonuses===
*[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Allies''' with [[Ironhide]] - +1~2~3~8% Armor.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Enemies''' with [[Ramjet]] - +2~3~8% Attack Rating.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Swordmasters''' with [[Bludgeon]], [[Drift]], [[Dinobot]] - <s>3~4~10%</s>  6~12~30% Critical Damage for each Sword Attack that isn't a critical hit until the next Critical Hit. (This does not count hits against opponents with active Crit Resist Buffs or while the Swordmaster bot has active Crit Rate Debuffs.) +6~8~12% more Critical Hits in Solo Missions.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Sky Assault''' with [[Waspinator]] and [[Starscream]] - 7~10~25% anti-evade.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Romance''' with [[Sideswipe]] - Windblade starts the fight with 17.5~35~80% of a Power bar.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Rivals''' with [[Slipstream]] - +5~4~8% Critical Chance.
*[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - +10% Critical Rating

==Strategy==

=== Commander ===
Windblade is the only Scout that doesn’t evade. Though not a Warrior, Windblade possesses formidable Bleeds. Stormfall Blasts will effectively disable any Power Gain, which means she will disable [[Robot Resource]]s, albeit temporarily (ESPECIALLY WHEN [[Megatronus]] IS ON ONE)

Her heavy attack is very useful for avoiding hard-hitting heavy ranged and special ranged attacks, especially hard-to-dodge shotgun blasts. Mirage and Slipstream also have this perk.

=== Opponent ===
Don't take any of her Bleeds, 4 stacks equals a Stun, which will be an utter nightmare.

===Strong Match-ups===

==== Bots ====
*[[Soundwave]]'s Power Gain can be neutralized by Windblade's Special 1. In addition, Soudwave's Heavy Attack is ineffective against Windblade's Heavy Attack.
* [[Ratchet]]'s Power Gain too.
* Windblade's Special 2 is great for piercing through Bots with tough armor like [[Megatron (ROTF)]], [[Grindor]], and [[Ramjet]].
* Windblade's Heavy Attack is great for avoiding Special Ranged Attacks like those from [[Waspinator]].
* [[Megatronus]] - Special I does serious damage because of his power gain, especially if Relic of Fury is on at the time and her heavy neuters his ranged attacks. If Megatronus' health is low (but not low enough to trigger his Relic of Immortality), her Special I or II can finish him off before the relic can kick in and protect him.

==== Mods ====
* Windblade's Special 1 can temporarily disable [[Robot Resource]]s and [[Superconductor 1000|Superco]][[Superconductor 2000|nductor]]s.

===Weak Match-ups===
==== Bots ====
* [[Bonecrusher]] will punish Windblade with every (sword) crit.
* [[Hound]]'s Precision Ammo are the only Ranged Attacks Windblade can't evade in jet mode.
* [[Tantrum]] - Frenzies will stop bleeds.
* [[Grimlock]] - Bleeding will only fuel Melee Buffs.
* [[Grindor]] - Windblade relies on Crits to strike Bleeds, but Crit Rate Debuffs weaken that ability.
*[[Ramjet]] - Ramjet will ignore the Stun after 4 stacks of Bleeds that Windblade throws if he has a lot of Momentum.

==== Mods ====

===Recommended Modules===
Make Windblade a potent Base Defender with these mods!
* With the [[Harm Accelerator]], Windblade always has a chance to Stun base raiders.
* The [[Nightbird's Mark]] will enhance her Critical Hits, meaning that she will always have a chance to Stun raiders.
* [[Paralyzer]]s will enhance Windblade's Stuns. This could be the worst case scenario when you're Raiding a base... and when you take 4 bleeds!

On certain Missions, Windblade comes packed with a [[Utility Module|Melee Bleed]] Module, which means that she will bleed your Bot ''all the time''. That and the fact she has the potential to stun your Bot makes her really deadly.
